purpose: Qualify Qwen2.5 0.5B Q5_K_M by measuring decode thread overhead without changing arithmetic, prompts or thresholds.
selection: Highest decode ratio among configurations preserving all 27 raw answers, token counts, prompts and evaluations and passing model contribution gates. Freeze winner before confirmations; no alternative selected from confirmation results.
success: Selected screening pair and both fresh confirmation pairs must independently pass unchanged production-rag-model-contribution-v6 and preserve the 16-thread outputs. Report >=0.85 throughput ratio separately as desirable margin, not a changed gate.
hypothesis: Fewer decode workers reduce synchronization and SMT contention on this small model. Not measured yet.
controls: 16 pool/prefill threads, same pinned model and released product JARs, greedy settings, 9 cases, 1 warmup and 3 measured iterations; only decodeThreads changes. Each pair unloads the reference before candidate generation.
limitations: One catalog RAG corpus tests this admission gate; it is not a broad quality benchmark. RAG report records output text and token counts, not token IDs. One host cannot establish cross-host performance.

fleet.stopCondition: Exit on completion or error, terminate-on-shutdown, 150 minute hard shutdown
